codes._message:
Your code to sign in to Vibe Site is 123456

Or open this link to sign in on this device:

https://vibe.test/auth/link?token=LINKTOKEN

The code and the link work once, within 10 minutes.

If you didn't ask to sign in, ignore this message: nobody can use it without reading your email.
email_change._confirm_mail: Confirm your new email for Vibe Site

Someone asked to move a Vibe Site account to this address. To confirm it's yours, open this link within 24 hours:

https://vibe.test/auth/email?token=CONFIRMTOKEN

Until then the account keeps its old address. If you didn't ask, ignore this message: nothing changes.
email_change._taken_notice: Email change attempt on Vibe Site

Someone asked to move another Vibe Site account to this address, which already has an account, so nothing was changed.

If it wasn't you, there's nothing to do.
email_change._undo_mail: Your Vibe Site email was changed

The email address of your Vibe Site account was changed to another one. If that was you, there's nothing to do.

If it wasn't, open this link within 7 days to put this address back and sign every device out:

https://vibe.test/auth/email/undo?token=UNDOTOKEN

Then reset your password at https://vibe.test/sign-in.
email_change._restored_notice: Your Vibe Site email was restored

The email of your Vibe Site account is this address again, and every device was signed out.

If someone else had changed it, reset your password now at https://vibe.test/sign-in.
factor_undo._undone/passkey: A passkey was removed from your Vibe Site account

The link in our email was used: the passkey it was sent for is no longer on your Vibe Site account, and every device was signed out.

Whoever added it knows your password. If you haven't yet, reset your password now at https://vibe.test/sign-in.
factor_undo._undone/totp: A authenticator app was removed from your Vibe Site account

The link in our email was used: the authenticator app it was sent for is no longer on your Vibe Site account, and every device was signed out.

Whoever added it knows your password. If you haven't yet, reset your password now at https://vibe.test/sign-in.
passkeys._added: A passkey was added to your Vibe Site account

A passkey was added to your Vibe Site account on 5 March 2026 at 09:07 UTC. It can sign in on its own.

If that was you, there's nothing to do.

If it wasn't, someone else has your password. Open this link within 7 days to remove the passkey and sign every device out:

https://vibe.test/auth/second-factor/undo?token=UNDOTOKEN

Then reset your password at https://vibe.test/sign-in.
passkeys._removed: A passkey was removed from your Vibe Site account

A passkey was removed from your Vibe Site account on 5 March 2026 at 09:07 UTC, and every other device was signed out.

If that was you, there's nothing to do.

If it wasn't, reset your password now at https://vibe.test/sign-in: that signs every device out, this one too.
password_change._notice: Your Vibe Site password was changed

The password of your Vibe Site account was changed on 5 March 2026 at 09:07 UTC, and every other device was signed out.

If that was you, there's nothing to do.

If it wasn't, reset your password now at https://vibe.test/sign-in: that signs every device out, this one too.
resets._reset_mail:
Someone asked to reset the password of your Vibe Site account. To choose a new one, open this link within 30 minutes:

https://vibe.test/auth/reset?token=RESETTOKEN

The link works once. Resetting signs out every device.

If you didn't ask, ignore this message: your password stays as it is.
resets._notice: Your Vibe Site password was reset

The password of your Vibe Site account was reset on 5 March 2026 at 09:07 UTC, and every device was signed out.

If that was you, there's nothing to do.

If it wasn't, someone can read your email: secure your mailbox first, then reset your password again at https://vibe.test/sign-in.
sign_up._verify_mail: Confirm your email for Vibe Site

Welcome to Vibe Site. Confirm this is your address by opening this link within 24 hours:

https://vibe.test/auth/verify?token=VERIFYTOKEN

If you didn't make an account, ignore this message: nothing more will be sent.
sign_up._notice:
Someone tried to make a Vibe Site account with this address, which already has one, so no new account was made.

If it was you, sign in at https://vibe.test/sign-in instead, where you can also reset your password if you've forgotten it.

If it wasn't you, there's nothing to do.
sign_up._resend_mail: Confirm your email for Vibe Site

Here is a new link to confirm this is your Vibe Site address. Open it within 24 hours:

https://vibe.test/auth/verify?token=VERIFYTOKEN

Any earlier link no longer works.
totp._added: Two-step sign-in is on for your Vibe Site account

An authenticator app was added to your Vibe Site account on 5 March 2026 at 09:07 UTC, so signing in now asks for one of its codes too.

If that was you, there's nothing to do. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.

If it wasn't, someone else has your password. Open this link within 7 days to remove the authenticator app and sign every device out:

https://vibe.test/auth/second-factor/undo?token=UNDOTOKEN

Then reset your password at https://vibe.test/sign-in.
totp._removed: Two-step sign-in is off for your Vibe Site account

The authenticator app was removed from your Vibe Site account on 5 March 2026 at 09:07 UTC, and every other device was signed out. Signing in now needs only your password.

If that was you, there's nothing to do.

If it wasn't, reset your password now at https://vibe.test/sign-in: that signs every device out, this one too. Then turn two-step sign-in on again.
totp._replaced: New recovery codes for your Vibe Site account

New recovery codes were made for your Vibe Site account on 5 March 2026 at 09:07 UTC, and the old ones no longer work.

If that was you, keep the new ones somewhere safe.

If it wasn't, someone is signed in to your account: reset your password now at https://vibe.test/sign-in, which signs every device out, then make new codes.
